coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification. Site CSP blocked computed-style evaluation; screenshots and source were used.

color.accent: Reason blue rgb(20% 61.1% 100%), approximately #339cff; used in featured pricing outline and cloud-computer links.

semantic_source.soft: 12% semantic color on the current surface

color.scope: Marketing now aliases chrome/editor/text tokens. Old sage-paper #f4f5f1 is not the current homepage identity. Dark definitions are source-only.

typography.fonts: Current marketing overrides use system-ui/-apple-system sans; Helvetica Now Display and Geist Mono remain in the shared application bundle. Do not choose a font merely because it is loaded.
typography.scale_source: Shared marketing title 32px/1.15, weight 400; copy 15px/1.5. Blog article override: h1 43px/1.1, tracking -0.04em; h2 26px/1.25; prose 17/26; lead 17/24.
typography.visual: Centered regular sans homepage and pricing titles, smaller plain navigation; editorial cards use large regular titles and quiet metadata.
typography.verification: CSS and screenshots; computed-style evaluation blocked by the site CSP.

layout.rails: Source page rail 1240px and text rail 760px.
layout.home: Centered heading/CTA over a wide white application composition with sidebar, transcript and browser/review panes.
layout.pricing: Centered heading and monthly/annual pills above three large light-gray cards; featured middle card has blue outline.
layout.index: Centered title, category tabs, hairline divider, entry count and grid/list switch; three-column image/title/metadata cards.
layout.article: Centered 760px prose; source left topic rail 220px at wide widths, hidden on narrow screens.

shape.actions: Black pill navigation/hero actions; pricing actions are full-width and moderately rounded.
shape.cards: Large rounded neutral plan cards and modestly rounded editorial images; source menu radii 8/10/14px.
shape.borders: Fine neutral alpha rules; featured pricing uses a clear blue outline.

elevation.base: Mostly flat paper surfaces; product presentation uses soft frame shadows.
elevation.principle: Reserve softness for product frames and floating controls; simple editorial text is unboxed.

components.nav: Flower mark and Reason Machines wordmark, Pricing/Resources/Index links, black Try Reason pill.
components.pricing: Three capacities, large price, short summary, full-width black CTA and icon-led feature list. Numeric prices are content, not design tokens.
components.index: Category filters plus grid/list toggle; imagery may be desktop UI, landscape or technical diagrams.
components.app_source: Sidebar 280px, detail panel 480px, settings cap 770px; editor/chrome tokens belong to product surfaces, not all marketing cards.

motion.source: home-hero-content-in, home-surface-visual-in, home-session-title-enter, marketing-logo-marquee, pricing-perk-flip and mobile-menu entrance utilities.
motion.scope: These names establish shipped motion families; exact timings and private application interactions were not runtime-verified.

design_style.mood: Quiet monochrome software studio with a selective sky-blue utility accent.
design_style.composition: Centered direct product claim and large application proof; spacious pricing and editorial catalogue.
design_style.imagery: Real-looking desktop UI and editorial cover images carry color. The old tonalist-painting marketing direction has been replaced.
design_style.continuity: Filename ara.json remains the existing lookup alias; the extracted site identity is Reason Machines.

visual_effects.technology: CSS/DOM product presentation and static imagery; current screenshots do not justify carrying over old painting/landscape effect claims.
visual_effects.source_motion: Entrance, title/plan swaps and logo marquee styles are present; do not describe every keyframe as active on every route.
visual_effects.scope: CSP blocked runtime probes, so shader/context absence is not asserted. Dark appearance and reduced motion are unverified.

page_families.https://ara.so/ → https://reasonmachines: Current white software-engineer landing; redirect verified.
page_families./pricing: Three light-gray cards, blue featured outline, black controls.
page_families./resources; /index; /blog: Current Index/editorial catalogue, categories and grid/list affordance.
page_families.article CSS: 760px reading rail with explicit system-sans overrides; no claim of visiting every article.
